decision_criteria.good_forecasting: BIS full-horizon MAE <= 5 and >= 5% improvement over persistence; descriptive diagnostic threshold, not clinical adequacy
decision_criteria.useful_action_gain: >= 5% MAE reduction versus state-only with patient-bootstrap CI excluding 0
decision_criteria.strong_ce: both CE R2 >= 0.5, and >= 0.1 above instantaneous-state control
decision_criteria.weak_ce: both CE R2 < 0.2 or no improvement over instantaneous-state control
decision_criteria.near_flat_timing: all absolute full-horizon relative degradations <= 0.02, assessed overall and at transitions
decision_criteria.substantial_wrong_action: MWAD / true MAE >= 0.05 with patient-bootstrap CI excluding 0
decision_criteria.evidence_floor: Underfitting, weak perturbation size, wide uncertainty or insufficient transitions preclude strong conclusions
